source: Persian writing (نگارش) grade 3, chapter 1 «نهادها», lesson 1 «محله‌ی ما». Card WRITING-01 (source docx, WRITING section): Quest, Village Plaza + School Route + Market, Drag → Snap → Sentence Assembly → Sequence, rail physics, H1–H3 verbatim, W01_ASSET_01..05, UI Sentence tray + order 1–4 + Undo, analytics, mastery «a coherent four-sentence description in a NEW environment», transfer «describe the library with four new pictures». Plan 04 row 01 (W-n = production step of P-n, run in the P-n room), plan 12 §1 row 4.
design_note: The four places are the ones the child actually walked through in Q01 (plaza houses and lamps → fruit stall → garden edge = park → school/crossroads), so the description follows the real route. Every sentence after the first refers back to the previous place («از خانه …», «بعد از بازار …», «آن طرفِ پارک …»); the order is therefore decided by the text itself (cohesion), which is exactly what the card misconception denies. The practice uses a NEW environment (library, 4 new pictures) with the same logic, as the card mastery requires.

answer_assist.note: match: only the right row and the trap row accept the plaque; sequence: the introducing row slides to slot ۱ and locks

reading.note: tap a plaque → the Reading Card; the listen button appears after 3 s (audio helps, never replaces reading, Persian card contract).
reading.tts_rule: tts_fa = the exact TTS input, LIGHTLY marked (user decision, round 13: full vocalization made the voice worse): text_fa as written + kasra only for a spoken ezafe that is not written (کنارِ), «ـهٔ» for an ezafe after a silent ه, a word-final sukun only where the voice would otherwise add a false ezafe (کتابْ قرض), and a vowel only on known homographs (پُر، گُل). No fatha/damma/tashdid/sukun elsewhere. Stripped of the marks it equals text_fa.

misconceptions.description: card: «هر جمله مستقل از جمله قبلی است و ترتیب جمله‌ها مهم نیست.» — the stamp is pressed on an order that breaks the chain of references
a sentence is joined to a place it only mentions (e.g. the market sentence «از خانه که …» next to the house): the card wrong answer «a market sentence in the school part»

mastery.note: card mastery = a coherent four-sentence description in a NEW environment → the library practice solved without Highlight (H2/H3 of either phase) and without Assist gives level 3; H1 and the read-aloud are allowed.

audio.on_wrong: soft_error (the plaque slides back along the tray, never punishing)
audio.on_solve: soft_success + star stamp + board lights up + luma_motif_3_note_ascending
